name: B10-0134/2024 (Verts/ALE) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on China to stop military pressure and coast guard patrols around Taiwan, and says China is wrongly using a 1971 United Nations resolution to claim Taiwan as its own. It asks the European Union and its member states to support Taiwan joining bodies like the World Health Organization and Interpol. It also urges China to respect the old unofficial sea boundary in the Taiwan Strait. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing legally; Parliament states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** China, Taiwan, and European Union governments and officials.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, Commission and others for follow-up.
